decisive_items: A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including clinical, histopathological, and genetic findings. C1 is the runner-up because it is an append-only completion of R3 and provides additional specificity regarding the SUFU gene mutation, but it does not provide any new information beyond what is already present in R3.

rejected.why: R5 is rejected because, although it matches the histopathological description, it does not account for the genetic findings or the broader clinical presentation, making R3 a more comprehensive diagnosis.
